name: Okefenokee National Wildlife Refuge
description: Okefenokee is a vast blackwater swamp straddling southeastern Georgia and northeastern Florida, and its name is often translated as "land of trembling earth." Wetlands, open savannas and forests cover roughly 400,000 acres, and fire and rain constantly reshape them. Visitors can spot many alligators and migratory birds, along with rare longleaf pine savanna and deep peat that stores carbon.
